title: Console Wiki empty when serve data root lacks project/wiki
description:
Wiki path must resolve from the .kanbus.yml parent, not blindly from the file-store root, so pages are found when the serve data root is project/.

Shipped on develop via PR #222 (contained in #223).

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: PR #222 and #223 covered empty-wiki honesty and directory titles. Both are merged to develop (0b808741 / 1b5f09e8).
